scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && vite build --mode development-build && pnpm run validate:build
scripts.build:production: node scripts/validate-production-env.mjs && pnpm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/validate-build.mjs --production
scripts.test:capture: node --test tests/adapter-registry.test.mjs tests/capture-matching.test.mjs tests/deepseek-sanitize.test.mjs && node --experimental-transform-types --test tests/repeatable-form-fields.test.mts && node tests/run-dom-fixture.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --pretty false
